src/sim.js bounce reflects only one velocity component at rounded inner-wall corners, so a shell fired from (-10.5,-12.5,45) retains positive x velocity instead of reflecting both components across the contact normal.
src/sim.js snapshot rounds heading 359.9999 to 360, violating the required [0,360) range.
src/sim.js:94 misses touching hits: firing from (-5,1.45) toward a tank at (0,0) leaves its health at 100 because contact uses < instead of <=.
src/sim.js:73 checks wall contact only at step endpoints, so firing from (2.973027,8.715846) at heading 315 passes within 0.22 units of corner (7,5) without bouncing despite the shell’s 0.25 radius.
src/sim.js:112 leaves the game in round_over after exactly two seconds because floating-point subtraction leaves a positive timer, delaying the next round until step 121.
